exposure: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosed by IADPSG criteria
Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosed by previous Chinese criteria
outcome: Glycometabolism outcomes (1-h plasma glucose, 2-h plasma glucose, HbA1c, area under curve of glucose)
finding: Implementing the IADPSG criteria for GDM diagnosis in China significantly increased the number of diagnosed cases, but the increment patients generally presented with milder conditions.
